purpose: Canonical machine-readable Capital State across the Registry with complete totals where proven and measured capital floors only where genuinely unresolved in-scope economic exposure remains.

semantics.measuredCapitalFloorUsd: Sum of non-overlapping current capital amounts proven by canonical sources. When all companies are complete this equals Network TVL.
semantics.networkTvlUsd: Populated only when every registered company has a complete non-overlapping total-capital binding. Company #010 Fluid is out of scope by owner policy, not an unresolved capital gap.
semantics.capitalLayer: Primary economic role. Productivity remains orthogonal and is not added again as a second capital copy.
semantics.productiveMeasuredExposureUsd: Measured productive exposure; never added to Network capital as a separate copy. Established general companies use the Productive exposure bound to the same General Balance source generation; a newer Productivity snapshot is diagnostic until General Balance is regenerated.
semantics.doubleCountPolicy: wrapper/LP/underlying/productivity representations contribute through one canonical economic path only
